name: Voxel Chunk Mesh Generation (Face Culling)
aliases: Chunk-based Voxel Rendering with Face Culling
definition: Generates a static triangle mesh for a chunk of voxels by iterating through occupied voxel positions and generating triangles only for faces that lack an adjacent voxel (face culling).
summary: Voxel Chunk Mesh Generation (Face Culling) is a surface extraction technique that generates static triangle meshes by emitting geometry only for faces adjacent to empty space, distinguishing itself by culling internal faces without merging coplanar surfaces.
